name: Josiah deGrasse
title: AI Engineer · Human Factors
summary: I build AI-assisted products that connect evidence, explain decisions, and keep people in control. My work combines Human Factors, product design, and implementation with AI development tools.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Human Factors Engineering

experience.context: Product development, Human Factors, and AI-assisted decision workflows.
bullets: Hired by the project sponsor to develop a Tufts capstone into a working sensory-intelligence platform for food-development teams.
Designed a connected journey across instrument evidence, sensory studies, insights, product decisions, concept testing, and reports.
Translated complex methodology into an explainable GO / TWEAK / STOP decision framework with evidence context and explicit human review.
Shaped role-specific workflows and reviewable AI assistance; used AI development tools to prototype and iterate on the working product.
Translated 8 discovery interviews into 3 deployment UX priorities as part of a five-person Tufts team.
Designed Figma Make prototypes for deployment diagnostics, YAML review, and editable hardware presets.
Iterated AI-assisted and deterministic concepts through a 4-person test and a 5-person Red Hat stakeholder review.
Designed production fixtures for robotic welders and CNC machinery, improving boiler-head throughput from 3 heads per 3-hour run to 8 per 45 minutes.
Created 1,000+ SolidWorks components and digital twins to support fabrication, documentation, and shop-floor decisions.
